plants.note: The search records Mr. Dobbs's key book clue, but the narration finds nothing and never tells what the book says.

ops.value: Mr. Dobbs's key book says: 'Greenhouse spare. Thursday: Mia, 5:05 to 5:20. Friday: Mia, 5:00 to 5:20. Saturday: Ms. Hale, 7:25.'

plants.note: Mr. Dobbs's slippers tell fires in his greeting, before anyone asks why he did not check the noise.

edits.find: He gives you a slow, kind smile.
edits.replace: He rubs the back of his neck and mumbles that he was already in his slippers. Then he gives you a slow, kind smile.

plants.note: Mr. Dobbs's answer is rewritten in adult words (immaculate, aforementioned, meticulously) a ten-year-old cannot read unaided.

edits.find: Stanley wipes his hands on a rag. "Boots? I've got big ones for muddy days. They're clean as a whistle this morning, though." He taps his key book. "I lent the spare to Ms. Hale at twenty-five past seven. It's all written down, of course."
edits.replace: Stanley methodically wipes his hands upon a rag. "Footwear? I possess substantial boots for inclement conditions. They were immaculate this morning, notwithstanding the weather." He indicates his key ledger. "I relinquished the aforementioned spare to Ms. Hale at twenty-five minutes past seven. Naturally, everything has been meticulously documented."
